opening.argument: The offer is presented as a straightforward store-opening promotion: “A new Chipotle opened up in Winter Springs, FL.” and “They were giving out free burritos.” The reported wait in severe weather is consistent with people attending an ordinary food event, not evidence of a separate deceptive mechanism. The footage likewise shows people gathered beneath a covered storefront walkway in heavy rain, while the title identifies the subject as “Free Chipotle!” Together, these details establish a conventional giveaway connected to a new restaurant opening. Although obtaining the food reportedly required standing in a thunderstorm for an hour and a half, that inconvenience does not by itself establish deception, financial loss, or any other mechanism beyond the described promotion.
